title: Similarities between Oppenheimer (2023) & The Theory of Everything (2014)

commenti.body:
Oppenheimer was just Theory of Everything done better, imo.

The Aeronauts was also Theory of Everything done better.

Theory of Everything was a rote, mediocre, insipid farce of a film, that cookie cutter sort of biopic that takes a big name and shallowly recounts their life in a series of career and romance beats injected with disingenuous wonder in aphoristic attempts at profundity.
